decisions.decision: Go with plan two (more expensive, 3-day delivery) for the holiday season
decisions.source_quote: So we do like this, we go with plan two. Final. We don't change this.

decisions.decision: Whether to use eco boxes or keep the old boxes for packaging
decisions.source_quote: About the packaging, we cannot decide yet. Some people want the eco boxes and some people want to keep the old boxes. Maybe next month we decide.

action_items.task: Send the signed contract to the shipping company
action_items.source_quote: For the contract, Jordan agreed to send the signed contract to the shipping company after the demo.

must_not_extract: Also, it would be good if the shipping company can give us a tracking dashboard.
